2608.31014.title: Evidence-Bounded Mental Health Reasoning from Heterogeneous Speech Protocols
2608.31014.paper_summary: Computational mental health screening using multimodal speech and text has shown great promise. However, existing models often assume all clinical speech protocols carry equivalent evidentiary validity. In reality, heterogeneous protocols, from free interviews to fixed reading tasks, support fundamentally different evidence. Forcing uniform reasoning flattens these boundaries, causing models to hallucinate symptoms from irrelevant text or overclaim support. Even advanced long chain-of-thought LLMs fail to resolve this issue, as free-form reasoning can exacerbate boundary violations. To address this, we reformulate multimodal screening as an evidence-bounded reasoning problem. We introduce the Evidence Package Benchmark, integrating 1,870 packages across six heterogeneous sources with explicit modality masks and evidence permissions. We further propose EviBound, a protocol-aware evidence control framework. Unlike direct LLM prompting, EviBound uses a profile-aware planner to restrict reasoning scope, orchestrates evidence tools via five-way acoustic consensus, and enforces a boundary critic to suppress unsupported claims. Empirical results show EviBound achieves a held-out test Depression AUROC of 0.8658, exceeding the strongest direct omni-modal baseline by +0.0811 AUROC while maintaining zero claim violations. Our work moves beyond unconstrained accuracy toward evidence-consistent, protocol-aware systems for safer clinical NLP research.
2608.31014.paper_summary_zh: 計算心理健康篩檢使用多模態語音和文本顯示出巨大的潛力。<lb/>然而，現有模型往往假設所有臨床語音協議具有相同的證據有效性。<lb/>實際上，從自由訪談到固定閱讀任務的異質協議支持根本不同的證據。<lb/>強迫統一推理會壓平這些界限，導致模型從無關文本中幻覺出症狀或過度聲稱支持。<lb/>即使是先進的長鏈思考LLM也無法解決這個問題，因為自由形式的推理可能會加劇邊界違規。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們將多模態篩檢重新定義為一個基於證據的推理問題。<lb/>我們引入了證據包基準，整合了來自六個異質來源的1,870個包，並帶有明確的模態掩碼和證據許可。<lb/>我們進一步提出了EviBound，一個協議感知的證據控制框架。<lb/>與直接的LLM提示不同，EviBound使用一個配置感知的規劃者來限制推理範圍，通過五方聲音共識協調證據工具，並強制執行邊界批評以壓制不支持的主張。<lb/>實證結果顯示，EviBound在保留測試中的抑鬱AUROC達到0.8658，超過最強的直接全模態基準+0.0811 AUROC，同時保持零主張違規。<lb/>我們的工作超越了不受限制的準確性，朝著基於證據、一個協議感知的系統邁進，以促進更安全的臨床NLP研究。
